And I didn’t even know I was running!

My Sojourners piece, “Is God Violent?” won second place in the Evangelical Press Association’s award in the category for Biblical Exposition. Here’s the article:

 http://sojo.net/blogs/2011/01/03/what-does-violence-bible-tell-us-about-god
